title: Conditional-Moment Estimation and Inference in the BLP Model
abstract: arXiv:2609.15736v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The random-coefficient demand model of Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes (1995) is commonly estimated by the generalized method of moments (GMM), using an unconditional moment restriction with a fixed set of instruments. Identification of the model, however, rests on a conditional moment restriction. The two are not equivalent: the unconditional restriction may admit additional parameter values. We construct a counterexample in which the model is identified by the conditional restriction yet standard GMM is not, even with the optimal instrument. Building directly on the identifying restriction, we propose a two-step estimator, following Ai and Chen (2003), that first estimates the relevant conditional expectations nonparametrically and then selects the structural parameters by a conditional-variance-weighted minimum-distance criterion; standard GMM is recovered as the special case of a linear projection onto finitely many instruments. translated_title: BLP模型中的条件矩估计与推断
translated_abstract: Berry、Levinsohn和Pakes（1995）提出的随机系数需求模型通常通过广义矩方法（GMM）进行估计，即使用带有固定工具变量集合的无条件矩约束。然而，该模型的识别依赖于条件矩约束。二者并不等价：无条件约束可能允许额外的参数值。我们构建了一个反例，在该反例中，模型能够由条件约束识别，但标准GMM即使在使用最优工具变量的情况下也无法识别。基于识别约束本身，并遵循Ai和Chen（2003）的方法，我们提出一种两步估计量：首先非参数地估计相关的条件期望，然后通过条件方差加权的最小距离准则选取结构参数；标准GMM可被恢复为向有限个工具变量做线性投影的特殊情形。我们建立了……
tldr: 本文揭示了BLP随机系数需求模型中标准GMM所用的无条件矩约束可能与识别模型的条件矩约束不等价（即使采用最优工具变量也可能无法识别模型），并据此提出一种直接基于条件矩约束的两步估计与推断方法，其中标准GMM被涵盖为线性投影的特例。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the unconditional moment restriction underlying standard GMM may fail to identify the BLP random-coefficient demand model even with optimal instruments, and proposes a two-step estimator built directly on the conditional moment restriction—using nonparametric conditional expectation estimation and a conditional-variance-weighted minimum-distance criterion—that recovers standard GMM as a special case.
